references.text: Jesus warns the disciples that many will come in his name and deceive many, which is relevant because it underscores the importance of being on guard against deception, as he has predicted.
It is mentioned that many false prophets will arise and deceive many, which again points to the need to be alert to deceptions, in line with Jesus' forewarning.
God tells through Isaiah that he declares the outcome from the beginning, and things that have not yet come to pass, which reflects Jesus' forewarning about future events.
Luke reports a similar warning from Jesus that many will come in his name, which is a parallel to the warning in Matthew.
God warns Moses that he will send a prophet whom the people should listen to, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' warnings to heed his words and be on guard against deception.
